about.conceptText: WeWise 微晓 is a concept for an AI insurance assistant inside a bank app. It helps people understand their policies, prepare claims safely and compare plans, and it shows its working in the Inspector.
steps: Plans the steps and calls tools.
Checks every answer against clauses and numbers.
about.notOfficial: This is not an official bank product and does not imply any partnership.
about.synthetic: All people, policies and outcomes shown are synthetic.

emergency.title: You're not alone
script: Take a slow breath. You are safe to talk to me.
First: is anyone hurt? If yes, call the local emergency number below.
Stay where it is safe. You don't need to decide anything about the claim right now.
When you're ready, I'll help you report this to your insurer and collect evidence, one step at a time.
emergency.speaker: Read aloud
emergency.duration: Call length {{time}}. Nothing was recorded or sent.
next: Call local emergency services if anyone is hurt
Report to your insurer within 48 hours
Take photos of the scene before anything moves
